scripts.build: vite build && cp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js dist/design/htmx.min.js && cp node_modules/htmx.org/LICENSE dist/design/htmx.LICENSE && pnpm build-storybook --output-dir dist/storybook && cp -R dist/storybook/. dist/design/ && rm -rf dist/storybook && cp -R backup dist/design/
scripts.test: playwright install --with-deps chromium && pnpm test-storybook-branding && vitest run --config vitest.storybook.config.ts && vitest run && vitest run --config vitest.visual-touch.config.ts
